catalyst_notes: Every table has system columns ROWID (PK), CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, MODIFIEDTIME - do not recreate; use as created_at/updated_at.
Tables/columns must be created in the Catalyst Console (no DDL in ZCQL; verify CLI before assuming).
Uniqueness is per single column; composite uniqueness uses the dedupe_key column.
Max 100 columns per table (dev). Varchar max 255.
Foreign key stores parent ROWID; on-delete null|cascade.
